notes.title: Workshop issue remind
notes.content:
We've found serious issues about workshop and will upgrade the patch asap. We suggest you to not use the workshop before the patch is out. The video library has many wallpapers for use. We apologize for the issues. Please give us some understanding and tolerance. We will work hard.
[list]
[*] It uploads only a very small part of the file, usually less than 1 MB.
[*] It often fails to upload a file.
[*] The download of workshop item is very slow.
[*] Sometimes it can't download wallpaper from workshop.
[/list]

tags.bug: [*] It uploads only a very small part of the file, usually less than 1 MB.
[*] It often fails to upload a file.
[*] The download of workshop item is very slow.
[*] Sometimes it can't download wallpaper from workshop.

notes.title: Patch upgrade
notes.content:
We've been fixing bugs in the past two weeks. The latest patch upgrade has fixed most of the issues mentioned by the curators.

Change log
[list]
[*] Launch time optimization.
[*] Run without having to launch Steam.
[*] Smooth run when switch the wallpaper.
[*] Change preview image for selected wallpaper.
[*] Fast load the wallpaper list on start.
[*] Show progress spinner when loading wallpaper list.
[*] Left mouse click on tray to call out menu
[*] Left mouse double click on tray to call out the main program.
[*] Localization of the video library.
[*] Keep the user's original wallpaper.
[*] No black screen wallpaper any more.
[/list]

tags.feature: - Launch time optimization.
- Run without having to launch Steam.
- Smooth run when switch the wallpaper.
- Change preview image for selected wallpaper.
- Fast load the wallpaper list on start.
- Show progress spinner when loading wallpaper list.
- Left mouse click on tray to call out menu
- Left mouse double click on tray to call out the main program.
- Localization of the video library.
- Keep the user's original wallpaper.
